_doc: Plain-language summaries of proposals/ files for the dashboard's 'Suggested agent tweaks' (one entry per file). status: pending (needs a yes/no) | applied (already in use) | superseded (replaced by a later tweak or by what is in use) | info (notes, nothing to approve). A ledger line proposal:approved/rejected always wins over this status. Checked against the agent files on 2026-10-05.

proposals/2026-09-ahangama-02/004-design.title: Designer must fix the flaws it spots before handing mockups to you
proposals/2026-09-ahangama-02/004-design.what: When the designer notices a problem in its own mockup (text hidden behind a button, a broken bar, overlapping parts), it either fixes it or tells you about it as a blocker before you pick. It may no longer note it as "known, not fixed" and hand the mockup over anyway.
proposals/2026-09-ahangama-02/004-design.why: On Layday and KA the designer wrote down three visible flaws and passed the mockups on regardless. The critic caught them later, and your Layday pick had to carry one of them as a condition.

proposals/2026-09-ahangama-02/005-copyed.title: Copyeditor must check every sentence against the facts, one by one
proposals/2026-09-ahangama-02/005-copyed.what: The copyeditor checks each sentence of the site copy against the business's facts individually, instead of giving one overall count. Words like "highest", "more than anything else" or "when the swell is up" count as claims that need their own source. Dropping a qualifier ("for advanced surfers") counts as an error.
proposals/2026-09-ahangama-02/005-copyed.why: On KA the copyeditor passed three invented or wrong claims. They cost an extra copy round, a failed critique and a rebuild.

proposals/2026-09-globalsurf-02/002-cust.title: Rewrite your designer taste notes to match your Global Surf feedback
proposals/2026-09-globalsurf-02/002-cust.what: Replaces the text of your own designer notes with your Sep 29 feedback: lead with the business's own video and photos, readable text plus one script font for titles, no decorative lines or borders, soft rounded cards are fine, booking inside the site.
proposals/2026-09-globalsurf-02/002-cust.why: Your current notes still say "thin black lines", "geometric sans only" and "minimal, extreme". That pushed the designer toward the near-empty pages you rejected. Until this is pasted, the agents are told your gate feedback wins wherever the notes disagree.

proposals/2026-09-ahangama-02/003-design.title: Designer looks at its own screenshots and revises; no more generic cream-and-serif look
proposals/2026-09-ahangama-02/003-design.what: The designer screenshots and revises each mockup at least three times, colours are sampled from the business's own photos, and the default "tasteful AI" look is blocked.
proposals/2026-09-ahangama-02/003-design.why: A spike on The Lavish Haven showed the pipeline itself produced the generic look.
proposals/2026-09-ahangama-02/003-design.status_note: In use since 21–22 Sep (designer 0.3.0, creative director 0.2.0, critic 0.3.0)

proposals/2026-09-ahangama-02/003-custom.title: Colour and type rules for your designer taste notes
proposals/2026-09-ahangama-02/003-custom.what: Cool clean colours, one strong colour, geometric sans, thin black lines.
proposals/2026-09-ahangama-02/003-custom.why: Your notes said nothing about colour or type.
proposals/2026-09-ahangama-02/003-custom.status_note: Pasted into your custom.md on 22 Sep; the Global Surf tweak above would replace it

proposals/2026-09-globalsurf-02/001-cust.what: Three lines of your notes rewritten so the designer leads with video and photos.
proposals/2026-09-globalsurf-02/001-cust.why: Every Global Surf mockup was rejected on Sep 28 for ignoring the media.
proposals/2026-09-globalsurf-02/001-cust.status_note: Replaced by the fuller rewrite from your Sep 29 feedback (above)
